info.title: Spacefast Partner API
info.description:
Publish files as a Space, then manage Spaces, versions, builds, domains, and teams. Every operation a person can run in the dashboard is here, for people and for agents.

Every path is versioned under `/v1`. A successful response wraps its payload in `{ data }`. An error is an RFC 9457 problem document served as `application/problem+json` with a stable `code`.

A deprecated operation also sends `Deprecation` (RFC 9745) and `Sunset` (RFC 8594) headers and a `Link` with `rel="deprecation"` to the policy: https://spacefast.com/docs/api/versioning

## Test mode

A partner account has two tenants, live and test, each with its own credentials. Test Spaces, principals, events, and webhook deliveries stay apart from live ones and are metered at zero. Configure the test tenant first, then copy its configuration to live with `POST /v1/tenants/{tenantId}/promote`.

Test mode can also simulate failures. Put one of the values below into the ordinary input it names, as the whole value or as one label inside it, for example `sf-sim-tls-fail.acme.dev`. The operation then fails that way instead of succeeding. There is no extra field and no extra route.

| Value | Put it in | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sf-sim-build-fail` | space slug | the space's next build fails |
| `sf-sim-domain-pending` | custom domain name | domain verification stays pending |
| `sf-sim-domain-fail` | custom domain name | domain verification fails |
| `sf-sim-tls-fail` | custom domain name | certificate issuance fails |
| `sf-sim-rate-limit` | space slug (on create) | the create returns 429 `rate_limited` |
| `sf-sim-webhook-retry` | webhook URL | delivery fails and enters the retry schedule |
| `sf-sim-suspend` | external principal id | the principal is suspended |
| `sf-sim-usage-correction` | space slug | the next settled usage sample appends a linked correction |

These values fire only on a test tenant. A live tenant treats the same input as an ordinary slug, domain, URL, or ID.

## Token issuers

An active token issuer `iss` is unique across Spacefast, so the test and live tenants must each declare a different issuer URL in their own system-space manifest. Activating a second issuer with the same `iss` fails with 409.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this channel was last repointed.

channels.description: Channel pointers by name. `live` is the only channel the API accepts, and it is absent until a version is promoted.

index.description: File served for a directory URL, so `/docs/` serves `/docs/<index>`. Set `false` to turn directory index resolution off. Defaults to `index.html` when the version commits one, else the only root-level HTML file when there is exactly one, else off.

fallback.description: Committed file served when no rule and no file matches the request. `"/index.html"` is how a single-page app is declared. Give the object form to choose the status.

path.description: File to serve. It must be committed in the version, or the publish fails.

status.description: Status to answer with. Only `200` and `404` are honored; anything else serves as `200`.

cleanUrls.description: Serve every committed `.html` file at its extensionless URL too, at any depth, so `docs/guide.html` also answers `/docs/guide`. Defaults to on, unless a fallback with status 200 is configured.

listing.description: Generate a browsable index for every directory that ships no `index.html` of its own, and turn on the built-in file viewer. Defaults to on only when no index file could be inferred, the version runs no worker, and no 200 fallback is configured.

meta.description: Title, description, social image, and icon added at publish to every committed HTML page that does not already declare them.

title.description: Page title and `og:title`, up to 300 characters. Also the heading of generated directory listings.

description.description: Meta description and `og:description`, up to 1000 characters.

image.description: Social preview image for `og:image`. A URL, or a path into this Space's files, which is served with a content hash appended so a change is picked up.

favicon.description: Browser icon. A URL, or a path into this Space's files. Without one, a committed `/favicon.ico` is used, and failing that a generated letter tile.

superpowers.description: Platform-managed script injection and custom JavaScript. Written through the Space's settings; a declaration in the config file is validated and then ignored.

enabled.description: Master switch. Set it false and no platform-managed tag, comment surface, or page metadata is injected.

disable_all_injection.description: Set it true to suppress every platform-managed script and tag, the same effect as setting `enabled` to false.

measurementId.description: Google Analytics measurement ID, of the form `G-XXXXXXX`. An ID that does not match that form is dropped without a diagnostic.

googleTagManager.description: Injects the Google Tag Manager loader for `containerId`.

containerId.description: Google Tag Manager container ID, of the form `GTM-XXXXXXX`. An ID that does not match that form is dropped without a diagnostic.

javascriptTags.description: Custom JavaScript injected into this Space's pages, at most 16 snippets. An entry with `enabled: false` is skipped.

code.description: Script body, up to 8192 bytes. A blank body is skipped.

inherited.description: Whether the owning team's tags are merged into this Space's. Defaults to on, and is always off for a Space with no team.

overrides.description: Team tags to leave out of this Space, by tag ID. Only entries with `disabled: true` change anything; `reason` is stored and never acted on.

requireReview.description: When true, applying a tag to a release environment through the API is refused until the change has gone through review.

templates.description: Files whose `{{ vars.NAME }}` placeholders are replaced with this Space's variable values at publish. At most 100 paths. A path the version does not contain is skipped with a warning; a name with no value, or a name that resolves to a secret, fails the publish.

theme.description: Colors, logo, name, and font for the pages Spacefast renders for this Space.

accent.description: Color used for buttons, links, and highlights on Spacefast-rendered pages. A hex, `rgb()`, `rgba()`, `hsl()`, `hsla()`, or named CSS color, up to 64 characters.

background.description: Page background on Spacefast-rendered pages, in the same color grammar as `accent`.

logo.description: Image shown in the brand row of Spacefast-rendered pages. An `https://` URL, or a path starting with `/` into this Space's own files.

name.description: Name shown in the brand row of Spacefast-rendered pages. Defaults to the literal `This space`.

font.description: `font-family` stack for Spacefast-rendered pages. Letters, digits, spaces, commas, hyphens, and quotes only, so `url()` and `src` cannot ride in.

hideSpacefastBranding.description: Removes the Spacefast wordmark from the footer of Spacefast-rendered pages. Requires a paid plan; publishing it on the free plan fails the publish.

build.description: Build settings seeded onto a repository connection created from this file.

ignoredBuildCommand.description: Shell command run before the build to decide whether to build at all. Exiting 0 skips the build; any non-zero status lets it run.

frameworkPreset.description: Framework the build assumes. It selects which directories are saved to and restored from the build cache.

allowUnsupportedPlatformFeatures.description: Lets a repository connect even when its `vercel.json` or `wrangler` config declares features Spacefast does not support. It permits nothing at build time. Defaults to false.

timeoutSeconds.description: How long a build may run, in seconds. 60 to 7200, defaults to 900.

burstable.description: Whether this Space's site may burst beyond its PHP worker allotment. Leave it unset to take the provider default.

placement.description: Placement controls for this Space. Written through the Space's settings; a declaration in the config file is validated and then ignored.

markdownNegotiation.description: Accepted and stored. Nothing in the serving path reads it.

dataSources.description: WordPress sites this Space's builds can read, keyed by the name a build refers to each one by. At most 32 entries. Builds receive the whole map as `SPACEFAST_DATA_SOURCES`.

propertyNames.description: Name a build refers to this source by. 1 to 128 letters, digits, or underscores, starting with a letter or underscore. `__proto__`, `constructor`, and `prototype` are refused.

url.description: Base URL of the WordPress site, up to 2048 characters. Must be `https://` with a DNS hostname of labels 1 to 63 characters long and 253 in total, a dotted-decimal IPv4 address, or a bracketed IPv6 address, plus an optional nonzero port and path. Credentials, a query, a fragment, a trailing-dot host, backslashes, control characters, and encoded slashes or percent signs are refused. The host case, default port, internationalized labels, dot segments, path escapes, and a trailing slash are all normalized before the value is stored, so what comes back can differ from what was sent.

additionalProperties.description: A publicly reachable WordPress site that repository builds can read content from.

defaultDataSource.description: Which `dataSources` entry builds get as `WORDPRESS_URL`. Must name an entry in the same config. Omit it and the first source by name is used.

config.description: Configuration overlay stored on the Space and applied over the live version's `sf.jsonc`. Each top-level key replaces the file's whole key rather than merging into it. Null when nothing is overridden.

settingsDigest.description: SHA-256 over the Space's title and `config` overlay. Send it back as `baseSettingsDigest` on an update to get compare-and-swap; `slug`, `noindex`, `pinned`, and `placement.burstable` fall outside the digest, so writes to them are never guarded.

noindex.description: When true, the production hostnames send `X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow` and serve a generated `robots.txt` that overrides any committed one. Version, preview, and branch hostnames are noindex whatever this says.

pinnedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the Space was pinned to the top of its team's list. Null when it is not pinned. The pin is team-wide, so everyone who can see the team sees it.

managedBy.description: Who owns this Space's git history. `spacefast`: push to `remoteUrl` and the push publishes. `github`: the Space publishes from `repository`, and no remote is handed out because the next sync would overwrite a direct push.

remoteUrl.description: Git remote to push to, carrying no credential. Null when `managedBy` is `github`. Authenticate over HTTP Basic with the username `t` and a Space key or API key as the password. Built from the current slug, so renaming the Space changes it.

repository.description: `owner/name` of the GitHub repository this Space publishes from. Null when `managedBy` is `spacefast`.

defaultBranch.description: Branch whose pushes publish to the live channel. `main` for a Spacefast-managed remote that names no other branch.

git.description: Where this Space's git history lives and who owns it. Null only on a deleted Space: every live Space has a remote, whether or not anything has been pushed to it.

defaultBranch.description: Branch whose pushes publish to the live channel. `main` for a Spacefast-managed remote that names no other branch.

claimUrl.description: Claim page at `/claim#<key>`. The key rides in the fragment, which browsers never put on the wire and the claim page strips before analytics load. It works until `expiresAt` and can be opened as often as needed.

get.description: Returns the Spacefast agent instructions as Markdown, filtered by `scopes` and sized for `consumer`, plus what the request's credential is. Works with any credential or none. A credentialed call adds a `credential` block naming the credential and what it is bound to. A user-owned interactive agent grant also gets a `capabilities` map of the operations its scopes allow.

schema.description: Instruction section keys to include, comma-separated or repeated. Omit for every section.
Client reading the instructions. Sets the size budget: `cursor` caps at 24,000 characters, `mcp` at 16,000, `markdown` is unbounded. Defaults to `markdown`.

consumer.description: Client reading the instructions. Sets the size budget: `cursor` caps at 24,000 characters, `mcp` at 16,000, `markdown` is unbounded. Defaults to `markdown`.

scopes.description: Section keys included in `markdown`, in reading order.

markdown.description: Agent instructions as Markdown. The same text for every caller.

truncated.description: True when the `consumer` budget dropped sections.

omittedScopes.description: Section keys dropped to fit the budget. Present only when `truncated` is true.

credential.description: The credential that authenticated this request and what it is bound to. Absent for an anonymous call.

kind.description: What the caller presented. `claim_token` is reported from the request alone: the Space key is checked against the Space it opens elsewhere, so nothing else about it is known here.

authorizationId.description: The credential's own stable ID, such as the API key it came from. Absent for a browser session.

subject.description: The account, team, or service whose authority this credential spends.

tenantId.description: The tenant the credential is homed in.

userId.description: The person who created the credential. Attribution only: a machine credential acts as `subject`, not as this user.

ownerPrincipal.description: The team or external customer that owns the credential. Absent when Spacefast owns it.

teams.description: The teams the credential is scoped to. Absent when it carries no team scope of its own.

teamIds.description: Teams the credential may act in. Each team appears once.

grantId.description: The grant this credential draws its authority from. Absent for browser sessions and Spacefast-owned credentials.

authorizationLevel.description: Whose authority the grant spends: `user` the person who authorized it, `team` the team they authorized it for. Absent exactly when `grantId` is.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for when the credential stops working. Absent when it never expires.

capabilities.description: Operations the calling grant's scopes allow. Present only for a user-owned interactive agent grant. Advisory only; each route enforces its own authorization.

default.description: Error. Every 4xx and 5xx response is one RFC 9457 problem document served as `application/problem+json`.

post.description: Publishes files to a Space and returns a receipt carrying its live URL, the version created, and the links to follow next. The body may be a JSON file manifest, a multipart form, one raw file, or a zip or tar project archive; `content-type` selects which. An archive that is already a website publishes at once like a manifest, while one that needs building goes to a Spacefast build and its receipt answers `next.action=poll` with the status link to watch until the build settles. On a Spacefast-managed Space, buildable source is committed to the Space's own git remote first and the build runs from that commit, so later pushes to the remote in the receipt's `git` block continue the same history. Pass `spaceId` to publish into an existing Space; without it a new private Space is created, and the call waits for the finalize unless `async=1` asks for an operation link instead.

parameters.name: async
parameters.description: Whether to wait for the finalize. Omit, `0`, or `false` waits and returns the finished receipt, falling back to a poll receipt when the request's time budget runs out. `1` or `true` returns at once with the operation to poll. An archive publish always returns a build to poll.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated key, up to 255 characters, that makes this write safe to retry. The first request with a key stores its outcome, scoped to the tenant, credential, method, and path. A retry with the same key and body replays the stored response with `Idempotency-Replayed: true`. A credential-free publish that sends this header must also send `X-Spacefast-Idempotency-Principal`. A different body with the same key fails with 409 `idempotency_key_reused`. A retry while the first request is still running fails with 409 `idempotency_conflict_in_progress`. Keys are kept for 24 hours.

parameters.name: X-Spacefast-Idempotency-Principal
parameters.description: Required with `Idempotency-Key` on a credential-free publish. A 64-character lowercase hexadecimal secret only the caller knows, sent unchanged on every retry. It keeps the stored claim and upload credentials from replaying to another anonymous caller. Never log or share it.

logo.description: Image shown in the brand row of Spacefast-rendered pages. An `https://` URL, or a path starting with `/` into this Space's own files.

name.description: Name shown in the brand row of Spacefast-rendered pages. Defaults to the literal `This space`.

font.description: `font-family` stack for Spacefast-rendered pages. Letters, digits, spaces, commas, hyphens, and quotes only, so `url()` and `src` cannot ride in.

hideSpacefastBranding.description: Removes the Spacefast wordmark from the footer of Spacefast-rendered pages. Requires a paid plan; publishing it on the free plan fails the publish.

build.description: Build settings seeded onto a repository connection created from this file.

ignoredBuildCommand.description: Shell command run before the build to decide whether to build at all. Exiting 0 skips the build; any non-zero status lets it run.

frameworkPreset.description: Framework the build assumes. It selects which directories are saved to and restored from the build cache.

allowUnsupportedPlatformFeatures.description: Lets a repository connect even when its `vercel.json` or `wrangler` config declares features Spacefast does not support. It permits nothing at build time. Defaults to false.

timeoutSeconds.description: How long a build may run, in seconds. 60 to 7200, defaults to 900.

burstable.description: Whether this Space's site may burst beyond its PHP worker allotment. Leave it unset to take the provider default.

placement.description: Placement controls for this Space. Written through the Space's settings; a declaration in the config file is validated and then ignored.

markdownNegotiation.description: Accepted and stored. Nothing in the serving path reads it.

dataSources.description: WordPress sites this Space's builds can read, keyed by the name a build refers to each one by. At most 32 entries. Builds receive the whole map as `SPACEFAST_DATA_SOURCES`.

propertyNames.description: Name a build refers to this source by. 1 to 128 letters, digits, or underscores, starting with a letter or underscore. `__proto__`, `constructor`, and `prototype` are refused.

url.description: Base URL of the WordPress site, up to 2048 characters. Must be `https://` with a DNS hostname of labels 1 to 63 characters long and 253 in total, a dotted-decimal IPv4 address, or a bracketed IPv6 address, plus an optional nonzero port and path. Credentials, a query, a fragment, a trailing-dot host, backslashes, control characters, and encoded slashes or percent signs are refused. The host case, default port, internationalized labels, dot segments, path escapes, and a trailing slash are all normalized before the value is stored, so what comes back can differ from what was sent.

additionalProperties.description: A publicly reachable WordPress site that repository builds can read content from.

defaultDataSource.description: Which `dataSources` entry builds get as `WORDPRESS_URL`. Must name an entry in the same config. Omit it and the first source by name is used.

config.description: Configuration overlay stored on the Space and applied over the live version's `sf.jsonc`. Each top-level key replaces the file's whole key rather than merging into it. Null when nothing is overridden.

settingsDigest.description: SHA-256 over the Space's title and `config` overlay. Send it back as `baseSettingsDigest` on an update to get compare-and-swap; `slug`, `noindex`, `pinned`, and `placement.burstable` fall outside the digest, so writes to them are never guarded.

noindex.description: When true, the production hostnames send `X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow` and serve a generated `robots.txt` that overrides any committed one. Version, preview, and branch hostnames are noindex whatever this says.

pinnedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the Space was pinned to the top of its team's list. Null when it is not pinned. The pin is team-wide, so everyone who can see the team sees it.

managedBy.description: Who owns this Space's git history. `spacefast`: push to `remoteUrl` and the push publishes. `github`: the Space publishes from `repository`, and no remote is handed out because the next sync would overwrite a direct push.

remoteUrl.description: Git remote to push to, carrying no credential. Null when `managedBy` is `github`. Authenticate over HTTP Basic with the username `t` and a Space key or API key as the password. Built from the current slug, so renaming the Space changes it.

repository.description: `owner/name` of the GitHub repository this Space publishes from. Null when `managedBy` is `spacefast`.

defaultBranch.description: Branch whose pushes publish to the live channel. `main` for a Spacefast-managed remote that names no other branch.

git.description: Where this Space's git history lives and who owns it. Null only on a deleted Space: every live Space has a remote, whether or not anything has been pushed to it.

code.description: Stable snake_case code for this diagnostic.

message.description: What happened, in a sentence a person can act on.

path.description: File or artifact path the diagnostic refers to, with a line number when known, for example `_headers:12`. Absent when it applies to the whole resource.

provider.description: Upstream system that raised the diagnostic. Absent when Spacefast raised it.

details.description: Machine-readable context keyed by the diagnostic code.

fix.description: What to change to clear the diagnostic. Absent when there is no known fix.

retryable.description: True when repeating the same operation unchanged can clear the diagnostic.

operation.description: Operation running against this Space or against its runtime record. Null when nothing is in flight.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last write to the Space. Automatic writes such as serving-state pushes, claim extensions, and storage rollups move it, so it is not a signal that a person edited something.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page. Null on the last page.

default.description: Error. Every 4xx and 5xx response is one RFC 9457 problem document served as `application/problem+json`.

post.description: Creates an empty Space under a team or external principal and returns it with its root access. A slug is generated when none is sent, and `access` applies only to a team-owned Space. To create a Space and publish files in one call, use `POST /v1/publish` instead.

teamId.description: Team that will own the Space. The same choice as `principal` with type `team`.

principal.description: Owner of the Space. Defaults to the principal the credential acts for.

type.description: Which kind of owner `id` names: `team` for a Spacefast team, `external` for a customer a partner manages.

id.description: Identifier of an owning principal inside one tenant: a team ID, or the customer ID a partner assigns its own end customer. 1 to 256 characters, no whitespace, no `/` or `\`, no control characters.

slug.description: Requested slug. It is normalized first, and one is generated when omitted.

config.description: Settings overlay to store on the new Space.

index.description: File served for a directory URL, so `/docs/` serves `/docs/<index>`. Set `false` to turn directory index resolution off. Defaults to `index.html` when the version commits one, else the only root-level HTML file when there is exactly one, else off.

fallback.description: Committed file served when no rule and no file matches the request. `"/index.html"` is how a single-page app is declared. Give the object form to choose the status.

path.description: File to serve. It must be committed in the version, or the publish fails.

status.description: Status to answer with. Only `200` and `404` are honored; anything else serves as `200`.

cleanUrls.description: Serve every committed `.html` file at its extensionless URL too, at any depth, so `docs/guide.html` also answers `/docs/guide`. Defaults to on, unless a fallback with status 200 is configured.

listing.description: Generate a browsable index for every directory that ships no `index.html` of its own, and turn on the built-in file viewer. Defaults to on only when no index file could be inferred, the version runs no worker, and no 200 fallback is configured.

meta.description: Title, description, social image, and icon added at publish to every committed HTML page that does not already declare them.

title.description: Page title and `og:title`, up to 300 characters. Also the heading of generated directory listings.

description.description: Meta description and `og:description`, up to 1000 characters.

image.description: Social preview image for `og:image`. A URL, or a path into this Space's files, which is served with a content hash appended so a change is picked up.

favicon.description: Browser icon. A URL, or a path into this Space's files. Without one, a committed `/favicon.ico` is used, and failing that a generated letter tile.

superpowers.description: Platform-managed script injection and custom JavaScript. Written through the Space's settings; a declaration in the config file is validated and then ignored.

enabled.description: Master switch. Set it false and no platform-managed tag, comment surface, or page metadata is injected.

disable_all_injection.description: Set it true to suppress every platform-managed script and tag, the same effect as setting `enabled` to false.

measurementId.description: Google Analytics measurement ID, of the form `G-XXXXXXX`. An ID that does not match that form is dropped without a diagnostic.

googleTagManager.description: Injects the Google Tag Manager loader for `containerId`.

containerId.description: Google Tag Manager container ID, of the form `GTM-XXXXXXX`. An ID that does not match that form is dropped without a diagnostic.

javascriptTags.description: Custom JavaScript injected into this Space's pages, at most 16 snippets. An entry with `enabled: false` is skipped.

code.description: Script body, up to 8192 bytes. A blank body is skipped.

inherited.description: Whether the owning team's tags are merged into this Space's. Defaults to on, and is always off for a Space with no team.

overrides.description: Team tags to leave out of this Space, by tag ID. Only entries with `disabled: true` change anything; `reason` is stored and never acted on.

requireReview.description: When true, applying a tag to a release environment through the API is refused until the change has gone through review.

templates.description: Files whose `{{ vars.NAME }}` placeholders are replaced with this Space's variable values at publish. At most 100 paths. A path the version does not contain is skipped with a warning; a name with no value, or a name that resolves to a secret, fails the publish.

$schema.description: Canonical JSON Schema URL for this response body. The server also sends it in the `Link: rel="describedby"` response header.

mode.description: `test` when the owning tenant is a linked test tenant, `live` otherwise. Derived from the tenant, never stored on the Space.

providerRef.description: WP Cloud `atomic_site_id` of the site serving this Space. Null until a box is claimed at the first publish.

providerClientId.description: WP Cloud client identity (`pvc_` prefix) the Space's site is provisioned under. Null until a box is claimed.

teamId.description: Owning team. Null for an anonymous Space and for one owned by an external customer.

teamSlug.description: Slug of the owning team. Null wherever `teamId` is null.

principal.description: The team or external customer that owns the Space. Null while it is unclaimed.

infrastructure.description: Where the Space actually runs. Absent unless the caller holds `infrastructure:read` on the Space's tenant.

region.description: Region the box serving this Space runs in. Null until a box is claimed, which happens at the first publish.

runtimeInstanceId.description: Box serving this Space. Null until a box is claimed at the first publish.

providerMainHostname.description: Hostname WP Cloud answers on for this Space's site. Null until a box is claimed at the first publish.

provisioningState.description: `provisioning`: no box yet, or the box is still warming, or the runtime is not installed on it. `converged`: the box is placed and carries an engine revision. `degraded`: the box failed.

anonymous.description: True while the Space has no owning team and no external customer. A Space whose claim window lapsed still reports true.

title.description: Display name. The live version's `name` config key wins over the stored title, and while that key is set the API refuses to rename the Space.

status.description: Where the Space is in its own lifecycle. Whether it serves traffic is the separate `disabled` field, and a disabled Space can still be `updating`. A deleted Space keeps `deleting`.

at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when serving stopped. Null when the reason was recorded without one.

disabled.description: Set while the Space is dark. Null while it serves normally.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the anonymous hold lapses. A claim-page read extends it by an hour, up to six hours of extension in total, and each publish pushes it six hours out, capped 30 days after the Space was created.

claimedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the Space was claimed. Null while it is unclaimed.

purgeAfter.description: ISO 8601 timestamp after which an expired Space's content is deleted, stamped seven days out when the hold lapses. Null before it lapses.

claimState.description: Anonymous-claim lifecycle. Null for a Space that never went through it.

expiryExtension.description: Present only on a read authenticated with a claim token that extended the hold, so a claim page can tell a granted extension from no change.

extendedTo.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the anonymous hold was extended to.

defaultHostname.description: Spacefast-owned hostname this Space always answers on. Renaming the Space moves it, and the hostname it moved off keeps redirecting here until the Space is renamed back, deleted, or an operator releases it.

publicName.description: Label the managed hostname is built from. Derived from the slug, with an environment suffix outside production and a numeric suffix when the label is already taken.

liveUrl.description: URL to open the Space at: its primary bound domain once that domain is active, else the default hostname. Always `https://` with a trailing slash, and always present on a Space that is not deleted.

kind.description: `screenshot` renders the page itself. `image` serves a preview file the publish picked, and is chosen only for a Space that lists its directory.

url.description: Render this to display the thumbnail.

sourceUrl.description: Page the thumbnail is taken from. It carries a token that opens a private Space, so treat it as a credential.

thumbnail.description: Preview image for dashboards, chosen by the server. Null until the Space has a live version.

dataLocation.description: Region the Space asked to be placed in, fixed at creation and refused on update. `auto` when neither the create request, the team, nor the tenant named one. Where the Space actually landed is `infrastructure.region`.

region.description: The same value as `dataLocation`. It is the region that was requested, not the region the box landed in.

burstable.description: Whether this Space's site may burst beyond its PHP worker allotment. Null while nobody has set it, which leaves the provider default in force.

archivedBytes.description: Bytes of this Space's versions moved out of the hot store to cold storage. A version is demoted whole, and the figure can read high until the runtime reports a promotion back.

hasRuntime.description: Whether the live version carries a worker or a Zero capsule, and so has a runtime surface. False for a runtime version that is ready but not promoted, and unaffected by what the team is entitled to.

versionId.description: Version this channel points at. A channel with nothing to serve is absent from the map.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this channel was last repointed.

channels.description: Channel pointers by name. `live` is the only channel the API accepts, and it is absent until a version is promoted.

index.description: File served for a directory URL, so `/docs/` serves `/docs/<index>`. Set `false` to turn directory index resolution off. Defaults to `index.html` when the version commits one, else the only root-level HTML file when there is exactly one, else off.

fallback.description: Committed file served when no rule and no file matches the request. `"/index.html"` is how a single-page app is declared. Give the object form to choose the status.

path.description: File to serve. It must be committed in the version, or the publish fails.

status.description: Status to answer with. Only `200` and `404` are honored; anything else serves as `200`.

cleanUrls.description: Serve every committed `.html` file at its extensionless URL too, at any depth, so `docs/guide.html` also answers `/docs/guide`. Defaults to on, unless a fallback with status 200 is configured.

listing.description: Generate a browsable index for every directory that ships no `index.html` of its own, and turn on the built-in file viewer. Defaults to on only when no index file could be inferred, the version runs no worker, and no 200 fallback is configured.

meta.description: Title, description, social image, and icon added at publish to every committed HTML page that does not already declare them.

title.description: Page title and `og:title`, up to 300 characters. Also the heading of generated directory listings.

description.description: Meta description and `og:description`, up to 1000 characters.

image.description: Social preview image for `og:image`. A URL, or a path into this Space's files, which is served with a content hash appended so a change is picked up.

favicon.description: Browser icon. A URL, or a path into this Space's files. Without one, a committed `/favicon.ico` is used, and failing that a generated letter tile.

superpowers.description: Platform-managed script injection and custom JavaScript. Written through the Space's settings; a declaration in the config file is validated and then ignored.

enabled.description: Master switch. Set it false and no platform-managed tag, comment surface, or page metadata is injected.

disable_all_injection.description: Set it true to suppress every platform-managed script and tag, the same effect as setting `enabled` to false.

measurementId.description: Google Analytics measurement ID, of the form `G-XXXXXXX`. An ID that does not match that form is dropped without a diagnostic.

googleTagManager.description: Injects the Google Tag Manager loader for `containerId`.

containerId.description: Google Tag Manager container ID, of the form `GTM-XXXXXXX`. An ID that does not match that form is dropped without a diagnostic.

javascriptTags.description: Custom JavaScript injected into this Space's pages, at most 16 snippets. An entry with `enabled: false` is skipped.

code.description: Script body, up to 8192 bytes. A blank body is skipped.

inherited.description: Whether the owning team's tags are merged into this Space's. Defaults to on, and is always off for a Space with no team.

overrides.description: Team tags to leave out of this Space, by tag ID. Only entries with `disabled: true` change anything; `reason` is stored and never acted on.

requireReview.description: When true, applying a tag to a release environment through the API is refused until the change has gone through review.

templates.description: Files whose `{{ vars.NAME }}` placeholders are replaced with this Space's variable values at publish. At most 100 paths. A path the version does not contain is skipped with a warning; a name with no value, or a name that resolves to a secret, fails the publish.

theme.description: Colors, logo, name, and font for the pages Spacefast renders for this Space.

accent.description: Color used for buttons, links, and highlights on Spacefast-rendered pages. A hex, `rgb()`, `rgba()`, `hsl()`, `hsla()`, or named CSS color, up to 64 characters.

background.description: Page background on Spacefast-rendered pages, in the same color grammar as `accent`.

logo.description: Image shown in the brand row of Spacefast-rendered pages. An `https://` URL, or a path starting with `/` into this Space's own files.

name.description: Name shown in the brand row of Spacefast-rendered pages. Defaults to the literal `This space`.

font.description: `font-family` stack for Spacefast-rendered pages. Letters, digits, spaces, commas, hyphens, and quotes only, so `url()` and `src` cannot ride in.

hideSpacefastBranding.description: Removes the Spacefast wordmark from the footer of Spacefast-rendered pages. Requires a paid plan; publishing it on the free plan fails the publish.

build.description: Build settings seeded onto a repository connection created from this file.

ignoredBuildCommand.description: Shell command run before the build to decide whether to build at all. Exiting 0 skips the build; any non-zero status lets it run.

frameworkPreset.description: Framework the build assumes. It selects which directories are saved to and restored from the build cache.

allowUnsupportedPlatformFeatures.description: Lets a repository connect even when its `vercel.json` or `wrangler` config declares features Spacefast does not support. It permits nothing at build time. Defaults to false.

timeoutSeconds.description: How long a build may run, in seconds. 60 to 7200, defaults to 900.

burstable.description: Whether this Space's site may burst beyond its PHP worker allotment. Leave it unset to take the provider default.

placement.description: Placement controls for this Space. Written through the Space's settings; a declaration in the config file is validated and then ignored.

markdownNegotiation.description: Accepted and stored. Nothing in the serving path reads it.

dataSources.description: WordPress sites this Space's builds can read, keyed by the name a build refers to each one by. At most 32 entries. Builds receive the whole map as `SPACEFAST_DATA_SOURCES`.

propertyNames.description: Name a build refers to this source by. 1 to 128 letters, digits, or underscores, starting with a letter or underscore. `__proto__`, `constructor`, and `prototype` are refused.

url.description: Base URL of the WordPress site, up to 2048 characters. defaultDataSource.description: Which `dataSources` entry builds get as `WORDPRESS_URL`. Must name an entry in the same config. Omit it and the first source by name is used.

pinnedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the Space was pinned to the top of its team's list. Null when it is not pinned. The pin is team-wide, so everyone who can see the team sees it.

managedBy.description: Who owns this Space's git history. `spacefast`: push to `remoteUrl` and the push publishes. `github`: the Space publishes from `repository`, and no remote is handed out because the next sync would overwrite a direct push.

repository.description: `owner/name` of the GitHub repository this Space publishes from. Null when `managedBy` is `spacefast`.

defaultBranch.description: Branch whose pushes publish to the live channel. `main` for a Spacefast-managed remote that names no other branch.

git.description: Where this Space's git history lives and who owns it. Null only on a deleted Space: every live Space has a remote, whether or not anything has been pushed to it.

message.description: What happened, in a sentence a person can act on.

path.description: File or artifact path the diagnostic refers to, with a line number when known, for example `_headers:12`. Absent when it applies to the whole resource.

fix.description: What to change to clear the diagnostic. Absent when there is no known fix.

retryable.description: True when repeating the same operation unchanged can clear the diagnostic.

operation.description: Operation running against this Space or against its runtime record. Null when nothing is in flight.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last write to the Space. Automatic writes such as serving-state pushes, claim extensions, and storage rollups move it, so it is not a signal that a person edited something.

key.description: The Space key (`sfc_` prefix). It is the only credential an unclaimed Space has: send it as a bearer token to publish, update, read status, share, rotate, and run the one-time continuation exchange. Returned when the Space is created and when the key is rotated, and never again.

url.description: Live URL carrying the Space key at `/__/<key>`. Opening it trades the key for a private view session and lands on the Space. It carries the key, so guard it as the key itself.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the unclaimed Space and this key expire. Claiming the Space clears the deadline.

default.description: Error. Every 4xx and 5xx response is one RFC 9457 problem document served as `application/problem+json`.

get.description: Returns the one Space a Space ID, hostname, URL, or slug points at. A slug is resolved inside the caller's own scope and fails with `ambiguous_space_slug` when more than one reachable Space matches; pass `teamRef` to pick a team.

schema.description: A Space ID (`spc_` prefix), a hostname or URL the Space serves on, or a slug.

teamId.description: Owning team. Null for an anonymous Space and for one owned by an external customer.

principal.description: The team or external customer that owns the Space. Null while it is unclaimed.

region.description: The same value as `dataLocation`. It is the region that was requested, not the region the box landed in.

burstable.description: Whether this Space's site may burst beyond its PHP worker allotment. Null while nobody has set it, which leaves the provider default in force.

archivedBytes.description: Bytes of this Space's versions moved out of the hot store to cold storage. A version is demoted whole, and the figure can read high until the runtime reports a promotion back.

hasRuntime.description: Whether the live version carries a worker or a Zero capsule, and so has a runtime surface. False for a runtime version that is ready but not promoted, and unaffected by what the team is entitled to.

versionId.description: Version this channel points at. A channel with nothing to serve is absent from the map.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this channel was last repointed.

channels.description: Channel pointers by name. `live` is the only channel the API accepts, and it is absent until a version is promoted.

index.description: File served for a directory URL, so `/docs/` serves `/docs/<index>`. Set `false` to turn directory index resolution off. Defaults to `index.html` when the version commits one, else the only root-level HTML file when there is exactly one, else off.

fallback.description: Committed file served when no rule and no file matches the request. `"/index.html"` is how a single-page app is declared. Give the object form to choose the status.

path.description: File to serve. It must be committed in the version, or the publish fails.

status.description: Status to answer with. Only `200` and `404` are honored; anything else serves as `200`.

cleanUrls.description: Serve every committed `.html` file at its extensionless URL too, at any depth, so `docs/guide.html` also answers `/docs/guide`. Defaults to on, unless a fallback with status 200 is configured.

listing.description: Generate a browsable index for every directory that ships no `index.html` of its own, and turn on the built-in file viewer. Defaults to on only when no index file could be inferred, the version runs no worker, and no 200 fallback is configured.

meta.description: Title, description, social image, and icon added at publish to every committed HTML page that does not already declare them.

title.description: Page title and `og:title`, up to 300 characters. Also the heading of generated directory listings.

description.description: Meta description and `og:description`, up to 1000 characters.

image.description: Social preview image for `og:image`. A URL, or a path into this Space's files, which is served with a content hash appended so a change is picked up.

favicon.description: Browser icon. A URL, or a path into this Space's files. Without one, a committed `/favicon.ico` is used, and failing that a generated letter tile.

superpowers.description: Platform-managed script injection and custom JavaScript. Written through the Space's settings; a declaration in the config file is validated and then ignored.

enabled.description: Master switch. Set it false and no platform-managed tag, comment surface, or page metadata is injected.

disable_all_injection.description: Set it true to suppress every platform-managed script and tag, the same effect as setting `enabled` to false.

measurementId.description: Google Analytics measurement ID, of the form `G-XXXXXXX`. An ID that does not match that form is dropped without a diagnostic.

googleTagManager.description: Injects the Google Tag Manager loader for `containerId`.

containerId.description: Google Tag Manager container ID, of the form `GTM-XXXXXXX`. An ID that does not match that form is dropped without a diagnostic.

javascriptTags.description: Custom JavaScript injected into this Space's pages, at most 16 snippets. An entry with `enabled: false` is skipped.

code.description: Script body, up to 8192 bytes. A blank body is skipped.

inherited.description: Whether the owning team's tags are merged into this Space's. Defaults to on, and is always off for a Space with no team.

overrides.description: Team tags to leave out of this Space, by tag ID. Only entries with `disabled: true` change anything; `reason` is stored and never acted on.

requireReview.description: When true, applying a tag to a release environment through the API is refused until the change has gone through review.

templates.description: Files whose `{{ vars.NAME }}` placeholders are replaced with this Space's variable values at publish. At most 100 paths. A path the version does not contain is skipped with a warning; a name with no value, or a name that resolves to a secret, fails the publish.

theme.description: Colors, logo, name, and font for the pages Spacefast renders for this Space.

accent.description: Color used for buttons, links, and highlights on Spacefast-rendered pages. A hex, `rgb()`, `rgba()`, `hsl()`, `hsla()`, or named CSS color, up to 64 characters.

background.description: Page background on Spacefast-rendered pages, in the same color grammar as `accent`.

logo.description: Image shown in the brand row of Spacefast-rendered pages. An `https://` URL, or a path starting with `/` into this Space's own files.

name.description: Name shown in the brand row of Spacefast-rendered pages. Defaults to the literal `This space`.

font.description: `font-family` stack for Spacefast-rendered pages. Letters, digits, spaces, commas, hyphens, and quotes only, so `url()` and `src` cannot ride in.

hideSpacefastBranding.description: Removes the Spacefast wordmark from the footer of Spacefast-rendered pages. Requires a paid plan; publishing it on the free plan fails the publish.

build.description: Build settings seeded onto a repository connection created from this file.

ignoredBuildCommand.description: Shell command run before the build to decide whether to build at all. Exiting 0 skips the build; any non-zero status lets it run.

frameworkPreset.description: Framework the build assumes. It selects which directories are saved to and restored from the build cache.

allowUnsupportedPlatformFeatures.description: Lets a repository connect even when its `vercel.json` or `wrangler` config declares features Spacefast does not support. It permits nothing at build time. Defaults to false.

timeoutSeconds.description: How long a build may run, in seconds. 60 to 7200, defaults to 900.

burstable.description: Whether this Space's site may burst beyond its PHP worker allotment. Leave it unset to take the provider default.

placement.description: Placement controls for this Space. Written through the Space's settings; a declaration in the config file is validated and then ignored.

markdownNegotiation.description: Accepted and stored. Nothing in the serving path reads it.

dataSources.description: WordPress sites this Space's builds can read, keyed by the name a build refers to each one by. At most 32 entries. Builds receive the whole map as `SPACEFAST_DATA_SOURCES`.

propertyNames.description: Name a build refers to this source by. 1 to 128 letters, digits, or underscores, starting with a letter or underscore. `__proto__`, `constructor`, and `prototype` are refused.

url.description: Base URL of the WordPress site, up to 2048 characters. Must be `https://` with a DNS hostname of labels 1 to 63 characters long and 253 in total, a dotted-decimal IPv4 address, or a bracketed IPv6 address, plus an optional nonzero port and path. Credentials, a query, a fragment, a trailing-dot host, backslashes, control characters, and encoded slashes or percent signs are refused. The host case, default port, internationalized labels, dot segments, path escapes, and a trailing slash are all normalized before the value is stored, so what comes back can differ from what was sent.

additionalProperties.description: A publicly reachable WordPress site that repository builds can read content from.

defaultDataSource.description: Which `dataSources` entry builds get as `WORDPRESS_URL`. Must name an entry in the same config. Omit it and the first source by name is used.

config.description: Configuration overlay stored on the Space and applied over the live version's `sf.jsonc`. Each top-level key replaces the file's whole key rather than merging into it. Null when nothing is overridden.

settingsDigest.description: SHA-256 over the Space's title and `config` overlay. Send it back as `baseSettingsDigest` on an update to get compare-and-swap; `slug`, `noindex`, `pinned`, and `placement.burstable` fall outside the digest, so writes to them are never guarded.

noindex.description: When true, the production hostnames send `X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow` and serve a generated `robots.txt` that overrides any committed one. Version, preview, and branch hostnames are noindex whatever this says.

pinnedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the Space was pinned to the top of its team's list. Null when it is not pinned. The pin is team-wide, so everyone who can see the team sees it.

managedBy.description: Who owns this Space's git history. `spacefast`: push to `remoteUrl` and the push publishes. `github`: the Space publishes from `repository`, and no remote is handed out because the next sync would overwrite a direct push.

remoteUrl.description: Git remote to push to, carrying no credential. Null when `managedBy` is `github`. Authenticate over HTTP Basic with the username `t` and a Space key or API key as the password. Built from the current slug, so renaming the Space changes it.

repository.description: `owner/name` of the GitHub repository this Space publishes from. Null when `managedBy` is `spacefast`.

defaultBranch.description: Branch whose pushes publish to the live channel. `main` for a Spacefast-managed remote that names no other branch.

git.description: Where this Space's git history lives and who owns it. Null only on a deleted Space: every live Space has a remote, whether or not anything has been pushed to it.

code.description: Stable snake_case code for this diagnostic.

message.description: What happened, in a sentence a person can act on.

path.description: File or artifact path the diagnostic refers to, with a line number when known, for example `_headers:12`. Absent when it applies to the whole resource.

provider.description: Upstream system that raised the diagnostic. Absent when Spacefast raised it.

details.description: Machine-readable context keyed by the diagnostic code.

fix.description: What to change to clear the diagnostic. Absent when there is no known fix.

retryable.description: True when repeating the same operation unchanged can clear the diagnostic.

operation.description: Operation running against this Space or against its runtime record. Null when nothing is in flight.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last write to the Space. Automatic writes such as serving-state pushes, claim extensions, and storage rollups move it, so it is not a signal that a person edited something.

default.description: Error. Every 4xx and 5xx response is one RFC 9457 problem document served as `application/problem+json`.

patch.description: Updates the Space's title, serving configuration, placement, search-engine visibility, or pin, and returns the updated Space. font.description: `font-family` stack for Spacefast-rendered pages. Letters, digits, spaces, commas, hyphens, and quotes only, so `url()` and `src` cannot ride in.

hideSpacefastBranding.description: Removes the Spacefast wordmark from the footer of Spacefast-rendered pages. Requires a paid plan; publishing it on the free plan fails the publish.

build.description: Build settings seeded onto a repository connection created from this file.

ignoredBuildCommand.description: Shell command run before the build to decide whether to build at all. Exiting 0 skips the build; any non-zero status lets it run.

frameworkPreset.description: Framework the build assumes. It selects which directories are saved to and restored from the build cache.

allowUnsupportedPlatformFeatures.description: Lets a repository connect even when its `vercel.json` or `wrangler` config declares features Spacefast does not support. It permits nothing at build time. Defaults to false.

timeoutSeconds.description: How long a build may run, in seconds. 60 to 7200, defaults to 900.

burstable.description: Whether this Space's site may burst beyond its PHP worker allotment. Leave it unset to take the provider default.

placement.description: Placement controls for this Space. Written through the Space's settings; a declaration in the config file is validated and then ignored.

markdownNegotiation.description: Accepted and stored. Nothing in the serving path reads it.

dataSources.description: WordPress sites this Space's builds can read, keyed by the name a build refers to each one by. At most 32 entries. Builds receive the whole map as `SPACEFAST_DATA_SOURCES`.

propertyNames.description: Name a build refers to this source by. 1 to 128 letters, digits, or underscores, starting with a letter or underscore. `__proto__`, `constructor`, and `prototype` are refused.

url.description: Base URL of the WordPress site, up to 2048 characters. Must be `https://` with a DNS hostname of labels 1 to 63 characters long and 253 in total, a dotted-decimal IPv4 address, or a bracketed IPv6 address, plus an optional nonzero port and path. Credentials, a query, a fragment, a trailing-dot host, backslashes, control characters, and encoded slashes or percent signs are refused. The host case, default port, internationalized labels, dot segments, path escapes, and a trailing slash are all normalized before the value is stored, so what comes back can differ from what was sent.

additionalProperties.description: A publicly reachable WordPress site that repository builds can read content from.

defaultDataSource.description: Which `dataSources` entry builds get as `WORDPRESS_URL`. Must name an entry in the same config. Omit it and the first source by name is used.

baseSettingsDigest.description: The `settingsDigest` read from the Space when the edit started. If the Space's settings have moved since, the request fails with 409 `publish_base_changed` and writes nothing.

force.description: Overwrite even when `baseSettingsDigest` does not match the Space's current settings. It is rejected without `baseSettingsDigest`, and the forced overwrite is recorded in the Space's activity.

dataLocation.description: Region the Space is placed in. It is fixed at creation, so only the Space's current value is accepted; anything else fails with `data_location_immutable`.

placement.description: Placement controls for the Space's box, merged over the same keys in `config`.

burstable.description: Whether this Space's site may burst beyond its PHP worker allotment. Leave it unset to take the provider default.

noindex.description: Keep the Space out of search indexes. It covers the production hostnames: the Space's managed hostname and every attached domain that serves it. Those hosts answer with `X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow` and a deny-all `/robots.txt`.

pinned.description: Pin the Space to the top of its team's list, for everyone on the team. Presentation only: it never changes what the Space serves.

$schema.description: Canonical JSON Schema URL for this response body. The server also sends it in the `Link: rel="describedby"` response header.

mode.description: `test` when the owning tenant is a linked test tenant, `live` otherwise. Derived from the tenant, never stored on the Space.

providerRef.description: WP Cloud `atomic_site_id` of the site serving this Space. Null until a box is claimed at the first publish.

providerClientId.description: WP Cloud client identity (`pvc_` prefix) the Space's site is provisioned under. Null until a box is claimed.

teamId.description: Owning team. Null for an anonymous Space and for one owned by an external customer.

teamSlug.description: Slug of the owning team. Null wherever `teamId` is null.

principal.description: The team or external customer that owns the Space. Null while it is unclaimed.

infrastructure.description: Where the Space actually runs. Absent unless the caller holds `infrastructure:read` on the Space's tenant.

region.description: Region the box serving this Space runs in. Null until a box is claimed, which happens at the first publish.

runtimeInstanceId.description: Box serving this Space. Null until a box is claimed at the first publish.

providerMainHostname.description: Hostname WP Cloud answers on for this Space's site. Null until a box is claimed at the first publish.

provisioningState.description: `provisioning`: no box yet, or the box is still warming, or the runtime is not installed on it. `converged`: the box is placed and carries an engine revision. `degraded`: the box failed.

anonymous.description: True while the Space has no owning team and no external customer. A Space whose claim window lapsed still reports true.

title.description: Display name. The live version's `name` config key wins over the stored title, and while that key is set the API refuses to rename the Space.

status.description: Where the Space is in its own lifecycle. Whether it serves traffic is the separate `disabled` field, and a disabled Space can still be `updating`. A deleted Space keeps `deleting`.

at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when serving stopped. Null when the reason was recorded without one.

disabled.description: Set while the Space is dark. Null while it serves normally.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the anonymous hold lapses. A claim-page read extends it by an hour, up to six hours of extension in total, and each publish pushes it six hours out, capped 30 days after the Space was created.

claimedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the Space was claimed. Null while it is unclaimed.

purgeAfter.description: ISO 8601 timestamp after which an expired Space's content is deleted, stamped seven days out when the hold lapses. Null before it lapses.

claimState.description: Anonymous-claim lifecycle. Null for a Space that never went through it.

expiryExtension.description: Present only on a read authenticated with a claim token that extended the hold, so a claim page can tell a granted extension from no change.

extendedTo.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the anonymous hold was extended to.

defaultHostname.description: Spacefast-owned hostname this Space always answers on. Renaming the Space moves it, and the hostname it moved off keeps redirecting here until the Space is renamed back, deleted, or an operator releases it.

publicName.description: Label the managed hostname is built from. Derived from the slug, with an environment suffix outside production and a numeric suffix when the label is already taken.

liveUrl.description: URL to open the Space at: its primary bound domain once that domain is active, else the default hostname. Always `https://` with a trailing slash, and always present on a Space that is not deleted.

kind.description: `screenshot` renders the page itself. `image` serves a preview file the publish picked, and is chosen only for a Space that lists its directory.

url.description: Render this to display the thumbnail.

sourceUrl.description: Page the thumbnail is taken from. It carries a token that opens a private Space, so treat it as a credential.

thumbnail.description: Preview image for dashboards, chosen by the server. Null until the Space has a live version.

dataLocation.description: Region the Space asked to be placed in, fixed at creation and refused on update. `auto` when neither the create request, the team, nor the tenant named one. Where the Space actually landed is `infrastructure.region`.

region.description: The same value as `dataLocation`. It is the region that was requested, not the region the box landed in.

burstable.description: Whether this Space's site may burst beyond its PHP worker allotment. Null while nobody has set it, which leaves the provider default in force.

archivedBytes.description: Bytes of this Space's versions moved out of the hot store to cold storage. A version is demoted whole, and the figure can read high until the runtime reports a promotion back.

hasRuntime.description: Whether the live version carries a worker or a Zero capsule, and so has a runtime surface. False for a runtime version that is ready but not promoted, and unaffected by what the team is entitled to.

versionId.description: Version this channel points at. A channel with nothing to serve is absent from the map.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this channel was last repointed.

channels.description: Channel pointers by name. `live` is the only channel the API accepts, and it is absent until a version is promoted.

index.description: File served for a directory URL, so `/docs/` serves `/docs/<index>`. Set `false` to turn directory index resolution off. Defaults to `index.html` when the version commits one, else the only root-level HTML file when there is exactly one, else off.

fallback.description: Committed file served when no rule and no file matches the request. `"/index.html"` is how a single-page app is declared. Give the object form to choose the status.

path.description: File to serve. It must be committed in the version, or the publish fails.

status.description: Status to answer with. Only `200` and `404` are honored; anything else serves as `200`.

cleanUrls.description: Serve every committed `.html` file at its extensionless URL too, at any depth, so `docs/guide.html` also answers `/docs/guide`. Defaults to on, unless a fallback with status 200 is configured.

listing.description: Generate a browsable index for every directory that ships no `index.html` of its own, and turn on the built-in file viewer. Defaults to on only when no index file could be inferred, the version runs no worker, and no 200 fallback is configured.

meta.description: Title, description, social image, and icon added at publish to every committed HTML page that does not already declare them.

title.description: Page title and `og:title`, up to 300 characters. Also the heading of generated directory listings.

description.description: Meta description and `og:description`, up to 1000 characters.

image.description: Social preview image for `og:image`. A URL, or a path into this Space's files, which is served with a content hash appended so a change is picked up.

favicon.description: Browser icon. A URL, or a path into this Space's files. Without one, a committed `/favicon.ico` is used, and failing that a generated letter tile.

superpowers.description: Platform-managed script injection and custom JavaScript. Written through the Space's settings; a declaration in the config file is validated and then ignored.

enabled.description: Master switch. Set it false and no platform-managed tag, comment surface, or page metadata is injected.

disable_all_injection.description: Set it true to suppress every platform-managed script and tag, the same effect as setting `enabled` to false.

measurementId.description: Google Analytics measurement ID, of the form `G-XXXXXXX`. An ID that does not match that form is dropped without a diagnostic.

googleTagManager.description: Injects the Google Tag Manager loader for `containerId`.

containerId.description: Google Tag Manager container ID, of the form `GTM-XXXXXXX`. An ID that does not match that form is dropped without a diagnostic.

javascriptTags.description: Custom JavaScript injected into this Space's pages, at most 16 snippets. An entry with `enabled: false` is skipped.

code.description: Script body, up to 8192 bytes. A blank body is skipped.

inherited.description: Whether the owning team's tags are merged into this Space's. Defaults to on, and is always off for a Space with no team.

overrides.description: Team tags to leave out of this Space, by tag ID. Only entries with `disabled: true` change anything; `reason` is stored and never acted on.

requireReview.description: When true, applying a tag to a release environment through the API is refused until the change has gone through review.

templates.description: Files whose `{{ vars.NAME }}` placeholders are replaced with this Space's variable values at publish. At most 100 paths. A path the version does not contain is skipped with a warning; a name with no value, or a name that resolves to a secret, fails the publish.

git.description: Where this Space's git history lives and who owns it. Null only on a deleted Space: every live Space has a remote, whether or not anything has been pushed to it.

code.description: Stable snake_case code for this diagnostic.

message.description: What happened, in a sentence a person can act on.

path.description: File or artifact path the diagnostic refers to, with a line number when known, for example `_headers:12`. Absent when it applies to the whole resource.

provider.description: Upstream system that raised the diagnostic. Absent when Spacefast raised it.

fix.description: What to change to clear the diagnostic. Absent when there is no known fix.

retryable.description: True when repeating the same operation unchanged can clear the diagnostic.

operation.description: Operation running against this Space or against its runtime record. Null when nothing is in flight.

default.description: Error. Every 4xx and 5xx response is one RFC 9457 problem document served as `application/problem+json`.

post.description: Creates a build for the Space and returns it, with an upload target when the input needs one. An `archive` input starts the build waiting for source and hands back the target to send the archive to; a `repository` input resolves the saved connection and queues the build straight away. Naming a managed `source` instead of an `input` builds the Space's configured WordPress source from its connected production repository, at the saved settings and the `live` channel, and requires an `Idempotency-Key` header: without one the call fails with 422 `idempotency_key_required`. Repeating an `Idempotency-Key` returns the build that key already created with 200 rather than 201, and reusing it for a different body fails with 409 `idempotency_key_reused`. A successful build mints a version through the same publish path as any other publish.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated key, up to 255 characters, that makes this write safe to retry. The first request with a key stores its outcome, scoped to the tenant, credential, method, and path. A retry with the same key and body replays the stored response with `Idempotency-Replayed: true`. A different body with the same key fails with 409 `idempotency_key_reused`. A retry while the first request is still running fails with 409 `idempotency_conflict_in_progress`. Keys are kept for 24 hours.

Send that hash to the per-table page read, which rejects a table whose shape has changed since instead of mixing it into the export. Rows there come back in `createdAt` then `id` order, and consistency holds within one page rather than across the export.

$schema.description: Canonical JSON Schema URL for this response body. The server also sends it in the `Link: rel="describedby"` response header.

schemaHash.description: Send this back as `schemaHash` on every page request. A page whose table changed shape since is refused.

consistency.description: Each page is read consistently on its own. The export as a whole is not one snapshot, so `schemaHash` is what fences the pages together.

ordering.description: Order the export walks: tables by name ascending, rows by creation time then ID ascending.

tables.description: Tables to page through, in export order.

default.description: Error. Every 4xx and 5xx response is one RFC 9457 problem document served as `application/problem+json`.

get.description: Returns one keyset page of rows from a declared table in `createdAt` then `id` order, up to `limit` rows, 500 by default and 1000 at most. `schemaHash` is the fence from the export metadata read, and the page is rejected when the table stops matching it. Follow `pagination.nextCursor` until `hasMore` is false.

schema.description: Schema digest from the export metadata call. A page is refused rather than mixed into the export when its table has changed shape since that digest.

post.summary: Apply the live capsule's migration plan
post.description: Queues the live capsule's declared migration plan against the Space's database and returns the plan with an operation to poll. Use it to retry a plan that did not apply during publish; the plan is pinned to the version live at the time of the call, so a later publish cannot redirect the retry. An empty plan queues nothing and answers `queued: false`. Requires `versions:promote`, and only a Zero capsule declares a plan: a worker returns `runtime_kind_mismatch` and a Space with no database returns `db_not_available`.

$schema.description: Canonical JSON Schema URL for this response body. The server also sends it in the `Link: rel="describedby"` response header.

queued.description: Whether an apply was queued. False when the plan has no operations, so nothing was queued and no operation is returned.

get.description: Returns the lines the Space's own code wrote in the requested window, newest first: a Zero capsule's queries and mutations, a PHP function, or a functions worker's handler. Requires `versions:read`, and a static Space writes none. Narrow with `requestId` or `handlerName`, and page with `cursor`; an empty page with `hasMore: true` means the scan stopped early, not that the window is exhausted. A line is shipped off the box and indexed before it can be read back, so a line a request wrote a moment ago is not here yet.

End of the window. Defaults to now.
Return only lines written while serving this request.
Return only lines from this handler, named as the Zero mutation or the functions handler that wrote them.

post.description: Save file operations as one Git commit. Spacefast creates a missing hosted repository for an initial commit. Send expectedHeadSha to reject stale writes. With sourceVersionId, preserve all original upload files before applying operations. The version must be current, ready, and a direct static upload. This option requires versions:read and versions:download in addition to spaces:write. Use 40 zeroes for expectedHeadSha and omit base or ephemeral branches. The hosted repository must have no branches, ephemeral branches, or tags. Upload bytes and replacement contents must total at most 4 MiB, with at most 1,000 uploaded files. A commit does not confirm deployment.

authorizedBy.description: The person whose authority an API key or an OAuth client acted under. Null for every other publisher type, and when that account is gone.

publisher.description: Who published the version. Null for an anonymous publish and for a version stored without attribution.

failureCode.description: Machine-readable code for the failure. Null unless the publish failed.

failedStage.description: Publish stage the failure happened in. Null unless the publish failed.

manifestHash.description: `sha256:`-prefixed digest of the version's file catalog. Null until the version reaches `ready`.

buildId.description: Build that produced this version. Null when the files were uploaded directly.

gitCommitSha.description: Commit this version was published from. Null when the publish declared none.

importedFromVersionId.description: Version this one was materialized from by an import. Null otherwise.

variables.description: Always null. The variable names and value hashes a version resolved stay internal.

fileCount.description: Files in the version. While the version is a draft this counts only what the publish declared, and it is replaced at `ready` with the served catalog.

totalBytes.description: Total size of the version's files in bytes, on the same draft-then-catalog basis as `fileCount`.

filesAddedCount.description: Paths this version added against the version it replaced. Written once at finalize, so it is 0 on a version that never finalized.

filesChangedCount.description: Paths whose bytes differ from the version this one replaced. Written once at finalize, so it is 0 on a version that never finalized.

filesRemovedCount.description: Paths this version dropped against the version it replaced. Written once at finalize, so it is 0 on a version that never finalized.

path.description: Where the file sits inside the version, as a POSIX path with no leading slash. Canonicalized on the way in to Unicode NFC and percent-decoded exactly once. `..` segments, backslashes, and control characters are rejected, and the canonical form is capped at 1,024 bytes.

sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of the bytes, 64 lowercase hex characters with no prefix. Omit it and the runtime hashes what is uploaded to a path-addressed target. sourceUrl.description: HTTPS URL for this one file. The runtime fetches and hashes it, so no bytes travel from the client.

pendingUploads.description: Files the publish still has to upload before it can finalize. Cleared at `ready`, so it is always empty on a finished version.

skippedPaths.description: Paths reused from an earlier version instead of being uploaded again. Cleared at `ready`, so it is always empty on a finished version.

immutableUrl.description: Permanent URL for this exact version, of the form `https://v{number}--{label}.{apex}/`. Fixed when the number is assigned, so it survives slug changes, transfers, and channel repointing. Null until the version reaches `ready`.
